Title: The Renaissance of Artisanal Bread Making: A Comprehensive Study
Abstract: This groundbreaking research explores the resurgence of traditional bread-making techniques in modern urban environments. Through extensive fieldwork and interviews with master bakers across Europe, the study documents the revival of sourdough fermentation, ancient grain varieties, and wood-fired baking methods. The findings reveal a significant cultural shift toward artisanal food production and its impact on community building and sustainable agriculture.
Description: A detailed examination of the artisanal bread movement spanning 2018-2024. The book includes step-by-step photographs, historical analysis, and practical guides for aspiring bakers. Features contributions from 15 master bakers across 8 countries, with detailed recipes and troubleshooting guides.
Subject_Tags: artisanal bread, sourdough, traditional baking, European cuisine, food anthropology, sustainable agriculture, fermentation science
Author: Dr. Elena Bianchi
